description: Return AI, MCP and data GitHub repositories that are new or hot, computed from the public GitHub Search API (stars, forks, licence and dates only; no README text). Window is day, week (default) or month. "What's new" is repos created in the window, ranked by stars per day since creation. "What's hot" is repos pushed in the window, ranked by stars with a penalty for repos younger than 7 days. This is trending by stars, not a recommendation. Optional topic filter. At most 25 rows per board.

topic.description: Only repos tagged with this GitHub topic

name: get_trending_repos
title: Get trending GitHub repos
